annotations.title: Get a Moda group join code

description:
Gets a person their Moda join code, the same as the form at modacommunities.com/join-code. Most Moda Facebook groups are private, and their join question asks for this code.
code_type private-group: the code for the free private Moda groups. Moda emails it to the person's address; it is never returned here. code_type moda-ai: the Moda AI Club join code (the group is private; the admin team approves join requests that match a sign-up), returned in the answer.
Moda saves the person's name, email and Facebook profile together before any code is released. Sending it means the person agrees to Moda's Terms (https://www.modacommunities.com/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://www.modacommunities.com/privacy); with a mobile number, also to Moda contacting them by phone or text (msg and data rates may apply, reply STOP to opt out).
Required: name, email, facebook_profile (a link to the person's own Facebook profile), code_type and agrees_to_terms. Optional for private-group: group and phone.
Returns JSON saying where the code went, or the code itself for moda-ai, or the reason nothing was sent.

agrees_to_terms.description: true when the person has agreed to Moda's Terms and Privacy Policy (and, with a mobile number, to calls and texts).

code_type.description: private-group (the free private Moda groups) or moda-ai (joining the private Moda AI Club).

email.description: An email address the person checks; the private-group code is sent there.

facebook_profile.description: A link to the person's own Facebook profile, such as https://www.facebook.com/their.name.

group.description: Optional, for private-group: the group they are joining. watchtrading (Moda Watch Club), 558871041349029 (Moda Watch Club: 10K & Under), watchbuying (Moda Watch: WTB/ISO), modaforum (Moda Watch Forum), 607987992210015 (Moda Clubs® - News & Announcements), cardealerclub (Wholesale Car Club: Dealers Only), carwanna (Wholesale Car Club: Forum), modatoys (Moda Bikes, Boats & Toys), modagold (Moda Gold Club), 440285754441122 (Moda Collective), modastocks (Moda Stock Club), modamisc (Moda Misc Club), 251355159780596 (Moda Meats & Eats: Culinary Arts).
